text:
emma: Hey all :wave: Planning a longer remote stint — 90 days in Barcelona (Nov 1 - Jan 30). Quick checklist: 1) does the WFH stipend apply (prorated)? 2) any payroll/homebase changes or tax registration risk for 90 days? 3) do I need to switch health coverage or file anything else? cc @people-ops

ava_peopleops: Thanks for the heads up, Emma. That falls into the "extended remote" bucket so we need a formal Temporary Remote Request + manager approval. See policy: https://go.redwood/remote-policy. Stipend: typically prorated and reviewed case-by-case for >30 days.

henry_payroll: From payroll: 90 days does not automatically change your homebase, but we will need the exact dates and confirm whether you maintain your legal residence/homebase. If you list Spain as your work location for payroll well have to change withholding and benefits enrollment. Please attach the request form with address.

sophia_tax: tagging in: Spain uses a 183-day residency test for personal income tax, so 90 days is under that threshold, but beware of local registration requirements and potential social security nuances if you do any local contracting or client-facing invoicing. If you plan to take customer meetings where we sign local contracts, escalate to Legal. Repeat or regular yearly 90-day trips can change risk profile.

claire_benefits: For benefits: as long as your payroll homebase stays the same, the Redwood benefits package stays active. However, our US-based medical plan may have limited coverage abroad; get the travel supplement or private international medical if you need care in Spain. If you enroll in a local public plan, we might need to update deductions.

mana_manager: Approved from my side. Please put calendar OOO blocks and share an on-call handoff for urgent requests.

emma: Thanks. One more: do I file an expense for short-term accommodation or is that personal?

ava_peopleops: Accommodation is personal unless pre-approved as business travel. Stipend is to offset remote work costs (internet, coworking). We will calculate a prorated stipend for 90 days after approvals.

sophia_tax: Also keep receipts and a short activity log (days worked, customer meetings) in case tax authorities ask about ties to Spain.

people-ops-bot: Temporary Remote Request submitted (ID: TR-9110) by emma. Status: pending approvals (manager, people-ops).

emma: Submitted the form and uploaded passport + proof of address. Appreciate the quick replies :heart:
